title: Domestic Electricity, Power and the National Grid

flashcard_questions.q: The flow of electrical charge around a circuit, measured in amperes (A).
Electric current that flows in one direction only, as supplied by cells and batteries.
Electric current that repeatedly reverses direction, as supplied by the mains.

flashcard_questions.a: The difference in electrical energy carried by the charge between two points in a circuit, measured in volts (V).
The electricity supply to homes and buildings in the UK, providing a.c. at approximately 230 V and a frequency of 50 Hz.
